purpose: Cross-check the textual holotype locality of Nomorhamphus rossi against independently georeferenced place evidence and modeled Philippine catchment geometry, while keeping the fish voucher distinct from the nearby herpetofauna site coordinate.

candidate.basinScope: Northern Luzon drainage-basin candidate. B0380 is distinct from Cagayan de Misamis in Mindanao.
candidate.globalDatasetRole: Discovery candidate only. The workbook does not map the listed taxonomy references to this individual species-basin association.

crosschecks.reportedTypeSeries: The 2025 checklist gives holotype USNM 333262 and paratypes USNM 363186 and USNM 363187 with the same locality/date; it cites Meisner 2001:272, figs. 68–69.

crosschecks.reportedTypeLocality: Baggao Municipality, Barrovia Barangay hot springs, Intel River; holotype USNM 333262; cited at Meisner 2001:272, fig. 68.

originalDescriptionAccess.citationFigureDiscrepancy: The Smithsonian record indexes Meisner 2001, pp. 272–273, fig. 66; the 2013 and 2025 taxonomic checklists cite fig. 68 (the 2025 checklist also cites fig. 69). The original full text was not available in this review to resolve the figure-reference discrepancy. The type number and locality agree.

typeLocality.interpretation: This is a historical textual type locality. No coordinate for the fish holotype or type-series event was found in the reviewed museum record.

coLocatedLocalityCrosswalk.sourceAccess: Full text retrieved from the official PMC EFetch XML endpoint and directly reviewed; source article is openly available.
coLocatedLocalityCrosswalk.localityVerbatim: Vicinity of hot springs on bank of Ital river
coLocatedLocalityCrosswalk.coordinateLimit: The coordinate belongs to the herpetofauna study's hot-springs locality, not to a fish specimen, fish collection event, or exact point in the Intel/Ital River. Table 1 does not state coordinate datum or uncertainty; WGS 84 was assumed only for the spatial check. The point is printed to 0.001 degree and should be treated as approximate locality context.
coLocatedLocalityCrosswalk.nameCrosswalk: The Smithsonian catalog and later fish checklists use Intel River; Brown et al. use Ital river for a hot-springs locality in the same municipality and Barrio Via. The shared hot-springs/place description supports a likely nearby locality relationship, but the Intel/Ital spelling difference and identity of the exact channel/pool were not independently resolved.

catchmentGeometryCheck.datasetCitation: Boothroyd, R. J., Williams, R. D., Hoey, T. B., MacDonell, C., Tolentino, P. L. M., & Quick, L. (2023). National-scale geodatabase of catchment characteristics in the Philippines for river management applications. University of Glasgow Enlighten Research Data. https://doi.org/10.5525/gla.researchdata.1396.
catchmentGeometryCheck.geometryDescription: The national research dataset contains 128 selected medium-to-large catchments, derived from 2013 IfSAR elevation data. Its source projection is WGS 84 Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere (EPSG:3857). These are modeled research catchments, not official surveyed boundaries.
catchmentGeometryCheck.method: Read the catchment shapefile and matching DBF from the checksum-pinned source archive; transformed the article's printed GPS coordinate from assumed WGS 84 longitude/latitude to EPSG:3857 and tested polygon membership using an even-odd ring point-in-polygon check.

directB0380PolygonOverlay.reason: The B0380 Zenodo shapefile download returned HTTP 403 with a notice that access was restricted because of unusual network traffic. The approximate article coordinate lies within the previously recorded B0380 bounding rectangle, but a bounding-box hit is not a polygon hit.

catchmentGeometryCheck.interpretation: This supports the co-located hot-springs place being in an independently modeled Cagayan catchment. It does not establish an exact coordinate for USNM 333262 or prove that the independent polygon exactly matches the global dataset's B0380 polygon.

gbifCrossCheck.interpretation: The zero-result GBIF coordinate query is bounded to the reviewed rectangle and time. It does not establish absence, and it does not negate the historical museum type locality.

overallInterpretation: USNM 333262 is a documented historical type locality at a pool in the named Intel River near hot springs in Barrio Via, Baggao, collected 5 May 1989.

A separate 2013 paper gives an approximate GPS coordinate for the vicinity of hot springs on the bank of Ital river in Barrio Via. That point falls within the University of Glasgow's modeled Cagayan catchment polygon, providing place-level support for a historical Cagayan drainage association.
The coordinate is not a fish voucher coordinate; exact Intel/Ital watercourse identity, the exact type pool position, and direct membership in the B0380 polygon remain unresolved.
No present-day population, abundance, continuous distribution, catchability, or fishing access follows from this historical type locality.

disposition.historicalPlaceLevelCagayanCatchmentAsso: Supported by the cataloged textual type locality plus a likely co-located hot-springs coordinate inside an independent modeled Cagayan catchment; exact fish point and direct B0380 polygon membership unverified.
disposition.reason: A related locality coordinate is not a substitute for the missing fish-voucher coordinates or a direct overlay against B0380. The evidence remains a research-only historical type-locality crosswalk.
